BREAKING: @The_DTCC to tokenize custodied assets on Solana. announced plans to connect the DTCC Tokenization Service to Solana, enabling the tokenization of eligible DTC-custodied assets on the network.

The integration is planned for the second half of 2027, further advancing DTCC’s multi-chain strategy.

Nick Ducoff, GM of Institutional at the Solana Foundation, on what DTC-tokenized assets add to the institutional capital already on Solana.

"Institutions are already issuing, settling and deploying capital on Solana. When the DTCC Tokenization Service is connected, eligible DTC-custodied assets are expected to be available onchain through the service."
